# Homework Questions

(@) **Polynomial and Nonparametrics**. Find data of interest to you with a continuous outcome and one continuous predictor and at least 100 data points. Fit 
    (a) Polynomial regression with degrees 2 and 5
    (b) Kernel smoother with bandwidths 0.1 and 0.9
    (c) Local linear regression with bandwidth 0.5
    (d) Local quadratic regression with bandwidth 0.5
    (e) LOESS with spans 0.2 and 0.8

Plot the fitted curves along with the data. Discuss how these fitted models differ.

<br>


(@) **Bootstrapped regression**. Consider the [soft drink delivery time data](../slides/data/data-ex-3-1.csv).
    (a) Find an approximate 95% bootstrap confidence interval on the regression coefficient for `distance` using $B=1000$ bootstrap samples. Compare this to the usual normal-theory confidence interval.
    (b) Find the bootstrap estimate of the standard deviation of $\hat{\beta}_1$ for `number of caeses` using the following numbers of bootstrap samples: $B=100$, $B=200$, $B=300$, $B=400$, $B=500$. Can you draw any conclusions about how many bootstrap samples are necessary to obtain a reliable estimate of the precision of estimation for $\hat{\beta}_1$?
